$Comment: Summon a wave of adds once, and tell the library a wave went out. Reference it inside a state's
Instructions (or hand it to a base script's FightBehavior slot):
Spawner is a manual-trigger spawn marker stamped near the encounter entity; Count 0 fires every
matching marker within Range. Signal is the beat the library hears (zc:wave, or zc:wave:<label>
to tell waves apart in a listener); it counts the wave and fires the generic signal event.

Range.Description: How far from the encounter entity a spawn marker may be to be fired.

Count.Description: How many matching markers to fire at random; 0 fires all of them.

Spawner.Description: The manual-trigger spawn marker the adds rise from.

Signal.Description: The beat sent as the wave goes out: zc:wave, or zc:wave:<label>.
